units.memory: bytes; PCM excludes decoder temporary allocations and total process memory

scope: Local phase 6 baseline vs phase 7; one sample per viewport, not a hardware survey
limits: OS cache may be warm; startup differences are not causal estimates
Before and firstCorrection use the same rapid paused transitions; final adds steadyMusic and briefing-specific prefetch
Headless RAF cadence is host-dependent and is not phone FPS
CDP 4x CPU slowdown does not emulate a phone GPU, RAM or speakers

before.method: file://, headless Chromium, real RAF, CDP CPU throttle; warm OS cache; PCM is buffer size, not process RAM

firstCorrection.method: file://, headless Chromium, real RAF, CDP CPU throttle; warm OS cache; PCM is buffer size, not process RAM

final.method: file://, headless Chromium, real RAF, CDP CPU throttle; warm OS cache; PCM is buffer size, not process RAM; music is rapid paused stress, steadyMusic is normal fade retirement
